label: Linq
description: Send messages and manage Linq iMessage conversations, reactions and blocked handles

operations.name: list_chats
operations.description: List one page of conversations; preserve the provider's next_cursor.

operations.name: create_chat
operations.description: Create or reuse a chat and send its required initial text message. First messages cannot contain URLs.

operations.name: update_chat
operations.description: Request a chat name change; confirm final outcome through Linq webhook events.

operations.name: send_message
operations.description: Queue a text message. Acceptance does not prove delivery; read the message status later.

operations.name: edit_message
operations.description: Edit a text part within 15 minutes of sending, up to five times.

operations.name: delete_message
operations.description: Delete the API record only. This does not unsend the message from recipients' chats.

operations.name: send_reaction
operations.description: Add or remove a standard reaction on a message part.

operations.name: get_attachment
operations.description: Read attachment metadata and its download URL; no file download is performed.

operations.name: block_handle
operations.description: Block inbound delivery and outbound sending for this handle.

operations.name: unblock_handle
operations.description: Resume inbound delivery and permit sending to this handle.
